entities.name: Ihsan
entities.description: A former Serra paladin of Aysen on Ulgrotha, turned into a ghost thrall bound to Baron Sengir's signet ring.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: An immortal vampire lord ruling from Castle Sengir on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Grandmother Sengir
entities.description: Source of the spell the Baron used on Ihsan; left behind on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Irini Sengir
entities.description: Yearns to take the signet ring and drive Ihsan mad.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who visited Ulgrotha around 4500 AR and saw Ihsan lead the vampire army.

entities.name: Paladins of Serra
entities.description: A quasi-military order of knights protecting the towns of Aysen.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Region of plains and towns on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: An event that closed the Dwarven Gate in New Freedom forever.

events.summary: Young Ihsan is told by a soothsayer that his dreams mean he is likely doomed by Baron Sengir, and devotes himself to becoming a paladin of Serra.
events.quote: Ihsan devoted his life to becoming a Paladin of Serra

events.summary: Ihsan confronts Baron Sengir and begs to become a vampire so as to defeat him.
events.quote: Lord Ihsan knelt before the Baron and begged that the Sengir make him into a creature of eternity

events.summary: Sengir drains Ihsan and instead makes him a ghost bound to his signet ring.
events.quote: Binding the paladin's soul to his signet ring

events.summary: The people of Aysen come to think Ihsan a traitor; the Serra paladins vow to destroy him.
events.quote: The Serra paladins have even vowed to destroy the traitor of their order.

events.summary: Leshrac sees a vampire army reluctantly led by Ihsan around 4500 AR.
events.quote: he saw a great army of vampires, reluctantly led by a giant in armor

relations.note: Bound as thrall to the signet ring.
relations.quote: Ihsan is a servant of Baron Sengir

relations.note: Former paladin, now regarded as a traitor.
relations.quote: The Serra paladins have even vowed to destroy the traitor of their order.
the ultimate destruction of Baron Sengir
